objective: Extend the C31 p=q=2 shared-boundary atom to the first nontrivial multiplicities and then to a period-continuable actual-host direction-packet theorem whose capacity defect is linear in r with a constant independent of growing p and q on its explicit domain; isolate the exact high-multiplicity nonperiodic boundary obstruction.

atomic_claims.text: For r=3^k, a=hm+b with m a power of three, and floor(p/2)<= (m-1)/2 plus floor(p/2)+floor(q/2)<= (r-1)/2, unions of disjoint affine direction factors followed by one Vizing repair give an actual host triangle packing with S<=h sigma_m(p)+pb+sigma_r(q); each leaf color is a genuine matching and every core edge has one owner.

When b=0 the construction has S<3r independently of p and q, and adding one whole m-coset changes no previous owner and increases S by the fixed local packet cost sigma_m(p), giving a genuine period-m continuation.

For every actual short cardinality, if p(p+1)<=r and p+q<=r-1, the least admissible power-of-three period gives an actual packing with S<6r and hence nu_star-nu<2r; the constant is independent of the multiplicities.

For p=3 and q in {2,3}, every actual A with a=3t+b admits an explicit two-direction actual packing with S=a+r+2b; for 4<=a<=r, explicit saturated primal formulas prove the full one-third face and nu_star-nu<=[a+r+2(a mod3)]/3<=(2r+4)/3.

For positive even multiplicity t, deleting one smallest color class from a Vizing (t+1)-edge-coloring costs exactly one core plus two endpoint units per deleted edge; an odd-component parity argument gives the lower bound |R|>=tc/2 and the supplied nine-point certificates attain it for t=2,4,6,8.

Translation slots P_s on a size-N fiber are pairwise edge-disjoint and a base triangle using slots s,t,s+t lifts bijectively; shared base edges are permitted only with distinct actual slots, and more than N full-slot requests on one base edge are impossible.

Selecting p canonical near-factor colors first on an affine block of order m leaves core defect e(m-1)/2-3 tau(D)>=p(m-p)/2, where e=m-p; therefore this route has a quadratic middle regime and cannot prove a multiplicity-independent linear bound.

Generator-side exact checks cover 240 cardinality constructions, 764 actual nine-core subset transports, 696 full-face substitutions, nine edge-color certificates, four exact even-repair certificates, all 512 nine-point omitted-color sets, 83 slot triples and three negative mutations; these runs do not prove the universal statements.

assumptions: Finite simple two-class split hosts with core order r=3^k and an actual arbitrary short subset A; relabeling is transported back to that actual subset.
The direction-packet theorem uses Vizing's theorem for finite simple graphs; Misra-Gries supplies a constructive Delta+1 algorithm premise.
The all-one-third equality is asserted only where an explicit saturated primal or the exact C28 interval calculation is supplied.
Every reported leaf class is an actual matching; Q, J, L_D and J_fix are not substituted for nu.
Prior C24, C28, C30 and C31 materials are generator-authored candidates, not trusted Evidence.
risks: For high p and an arbitrary nonperiodic short cardinality, the residual pb term remains; eliminating it requires a balanced partial-Latin boundary trade whose completion and slot constraints are both proved.
The displayed actual packings are lower-bound witnesses and do not determine the exact value of nu except where separately stated; no exact p=3 optimum is claimed.
Vizing and Misra-Gries were source-audited from bibliographic or abstract metadata, not independently formalized here.
The transported checker is source-equivalent to the locally executed checker, but byte identity is not asserted; all finite execution remains in the generator trust domain.
No trusted verifier, semantic review, EvidenceLink, Result, Solution, exact split-domination theorem or ProblemContract closure is generated.

failed_route_proposal.blocker: The route that selects p near-factor leaf colors first and retains only untouched affine triples has S_core>=p(m-p)/2. When p and m-p are both linear in m this contradicts the required O(m) packet defect.
